title: Jay's Minigame Network
description: This project adds popular minigames such as bedwars, mace survival, survival games, and other gamemodes coming out soon! In beta right now!
body:
Jay's Minigame Network is a Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that turns your singleplayer world into a fully self-contained minigame network. It adds six game modes accessible through colored walk-through portals in a central hub: Sword PvP with five kit tiers, Bedwars with resource generators and a villager shop, Survival Games with randomized themed arenas, Mace Survival with open-world combat and a death kit system, Shop Survival with an economy, /sethome, /rtp, and a full TPA system, and Armadillo Soccer with bot players to duel against. Every game mode has completely isolated inventories that save and restore automatically when you switch.

There is zero setup required. Load the mod, create a new Superflat world with the Void preset enabled and the entire hub and all arenas generate automatically on first launch. All textures are included in the mod file — nothing extra to install or configure.
Important: This mod is designed for singleplayer only and requires Minecraft 1.21.11 and Fabric API. It will not work on other Minecraft versions or with Forge/NeoForge. A Superflat or Void world type is strongly recommended, as the mod generates all its own structures and arenas at specific coordinates that may conflict with natural terrain.

Please note that all minigames are in beta development right now and might have many errors. This is an unfinished project. The description above explains the goal of this project. The description above was made using AI.
